summary: New dellemc.openmanage modules in 10.7.0: omevv_baseline_profile, omevv_baseline_profile_info and omevv_compliance_info for OMEVV baseline profiles and firmware compliance reports.
questions: Which module manages OMEVV baseline profiles?
How can I get firmware compliance reports from OMEVV with Ansible?

answer_card.title: New OMEVV modules in 10.7.0
answer_card.answer_md:
- `omevv_baseline_profile`: manage baseline profiles
- `omevv_baseline_profile_info`: retrieve baseline profile info
- `omevv_compliance_info`: retrieve firmware compliance reports
